rows.statement: A representation-independent unique cognitive atom cannot be inferred from computational composition alone because units may be split/refactored and finite networks may be merged/flattened without changing external computation.
rows.consequence: Any irreducibility claim must declare locality/physics/resources/equivalence scope.

rows.statement: No computable exact universal predictor can return arbitrary Turing-complete morphology target-reachability/developmental burden in full generality; otherwise halting/reachability can be decided.
rows.consequence: Useful phase laws must restrict machine/ecology classes or provide probabilistic/empirical guarantees.

rows.statement: A finite developmental burden vector does not identify a unique morphology: an ordinary finite program/transducer can realize any prescribed positive integer burden vector over a finite target set.
rows.consequence: Pre-outcome structure-to-burden causality is required; phenotype vectors alone do not establish intelligence-form identity.

rows.statement: For a finite deterministic machine whose event alphabet includes developmental events, future-trace equivalence induces a minimal deterministic quotient unique up to isomorphism under the registered trace semantics.
rows.consequence: Task-relative minimal developmental state is well posed; this does not imply a universal cognitive atom.

rows.statement: Generic approximate developmental-state equivalence can in principle be reduced to bisimulation/state abstraction on an enlarged learner meta-state.
rows.residual: factorized, resource-aware, open-ended developmental abstraction and cross-paradigm scaling

rows.statement: Programmatic-library, Bayesian-prior and quadratic-gradient toy morphologies all exhibit ecology-dependent burden reversals, but their common form is only an ecology-weighted morphology cost vector.

A product of universal computation, AutoML/search, meta-learning, algorithm selection, resource rationality, drift/SSP theory and modern hybrid systems covers most of the broad conceptual GMI scaffold.
Legal pre-target OCM validation geometry predicts the sign of later protected proposal-rank shift on independent fresh fixed-controller worlds.

There exists a compact pre-outcome signature derived from structure/update/history that predicts developmental burden/frontier across at least two materially different morphology paradigms better than family-specific parent baselines.
